Title: MemorySmith.Agent — Game Testing Readiness
Content:
## Current State (2026-07-10)

The WebSocket bridge, Mineflayer adapter, and agent pipeline have matured significantly since initial setup. Below is the current baseline for running a live Minecraft agent test.

## Architecture Overview

- **C# Host:** WebUI.Blazor (or any host registering Agent:Enabled=true) runs AgentBackgroundService (IHostedService) managing the full agent lifecycle
- **Node.js Adapter:** MineflayerAdapter/index.js is a standalone ESM module that launches a Mineflayer bot, runs a WebSocket server on WS_PORT (default 3000), receives actions from C#, and sends events back
- **Connection:** MinecraftAdapter (C#) spawns index.js as a subprocess, connects via WebSocket, forwards ActionData commands using the ActionProtocol wire format ({action, arguments, correlationId})
- **Validation:** The agent pipeline can also be tested without a live Minecraft server using MockWorldAdapter

## Pre-Game Testing Checklist

- [ ] Run 'npm install' in MineflayerAdapter/ to get dependencies (mineflayer, mineflayer-pathfinder, ws)
- [ ] Start a Minecraft server: vanilla or Paper, version 1.16.4+ (1.20+ recommended for pathfinder)
- [ ] Set Agent:Enabled=true in WebUI.Blazor/appsettings.json
- [ ] Set Agent:Minecraft:ServerHost, ServerPort, BotUsername
- [ ] Set Agent:Minecraft:AutoStartNode:true, Agent:Minecraft:NodeScriptPath:../MineflayerAdapter/index.js
- [ ] dotnet run --project WebUI.Blazor
- [ ] Watch logs for 'Mineflayer adapter starting' then 'Bot spawned' then 'World adapter connected'
- [ ] POST /api/agent/plan with {goalName:"GatherWood", parameters:{count:5}} and watch bot in game

## Troubleshooting

| Symptom | Likely Cause | Fix |
|---------|-------------|-----|
| Bot connects but doesn't pathfind | mineflayer-pathfinder not installed or server version < 1.16.4 | npm install in MineflayerAdapter/, verify server version |
| WebSocket connection refused | WS_PORT mismatch or adapter didn't start | Check port config, verify AutoStartNode path |
| Actions timeout | goto() has no explicit timeout (known gap) | See TSK-0165 area — add timeout to goto calls |
| Items not detected after pickup | playerCollect guard insufficient | Verify entity?.metadata fallback chain |
| /op or /give fails silently | LAN world has no permissions system | Use bot.creative.setInventorySlot() instead

## LAN World Notes (Sprint 52)

The /op command does NOT work in "Open to LAN" singleplayer worlds — there is no permissions system. All players have equal rights. /give @p also does not function via chat on LAN worlds. Use bot.creative.setInventorySlot() (Mineflayer creative API) which works on all versions. The creativeProvider.js module handles this with a /give fallback for dedicated servers where OP is available.

## Testing Without a Server

- Use MockWorldAdapter for unit/pipeline tests (746+ tests, none require live Minecraft)
- Use MemorySmith test fixtures (Data/Memories copied to temp) for memory/blueprint tests
- The full test suite runs in CI on ubuntu-latest without a Minecraft server

## Key Configuration

| Config Key | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| Agent:Enabled | false | Master agent toggle |
| Agent:Minecraft:ServerHost | localhost | Minecraft server host |
| Agent:Minecraft:ServerPort | 25565 | Minecraft server port |
| Agent:Minecraft:BotUsername | MemoryBot | In-game bot name |
| Agent:Minecraft:AutoStartNode | true | Auto-launch Node.js adapter |
| Agent:Minecraft:NodeScriptPath | ../MineflayerAdapter/index.js | Path to adapter script |
| Agent:Minecraft:WsPort | 3000 | WebSocket port for C#↔Node bridge |
| Agent:Minecraft:ReconnectDelays | [2,4,8,16,32] | Exponential backoff in seconds |
